name: APTDC Gandikota Haritha Hotel Restaurant
why_it_matters: The restaurant at APTDC's Gandikota Haritha Hotel, about 1.4km from the fort — the only real place to eat in this remote canyon village. Food is basic and famously spicy (travellers note the roasted cashews arrive with a fistful of fried chillies). With no standalone restaurants in the village, this is effectively the dining at Gandikota.
insider_tip: Crucial: on weekdays the hotel runs near-empty and plans food to demand — without prior booking, lunch can be just fried rice or egg fried rice. Phone ahead and tell them what you want, especially midweek.
signature_address: APTDC Gandikota Haritha Hotel, Gandikota, Kadapa District 516434

name: Gandikota Fort-Side Snack Shops
why_it_matters: The handful of small shops scattered around the Gandikota Fort area selling tea, biscuits, chips, cold drinks and water. They do not serve lunch — only basic packaged snacks — but in a village this remote, perched above the Pennar river gorge, they are the only quick re-stock point while exploring the fort and canyon rim.
insider_tip: Do not count on these for a meal — they stock snacks, not cooked food. Buy water here before walking the fort and canyon rim, and carry your own food or rely on the Haritha restaurant for lunch.
signature_address: Gandikota Fort area, Gandikota village, Kadapa District 516434

name: Gandikota Restaurant (Jammalamadugu)
why_it_matters: A standalone restaurant in Palur, Jammalamadugu — the gateway town ~15km from Gandikota — with a wider menu of South Indian meals, biryani and Chinese. Since the route to Gandikota has almost no food and the village itself only has the Haritha restaurant, this is the practical fuller meal stop on the Jammalamadugu leg of the trip.
insider_tip: Beside Bharath Petroleum near the Government Degree College in Palur — easy to fold into the drive in or out. Open 11am-11pm; useful for a proper lunch before the canyon or dinner on the way back.
signature_address: Beside Bharath Petroleum, behind Government Degree College, Palur, Jammalamadugu 516434
